meta.name: chrome-automation
meta.description: Connect to and control Google Chrome browser using agent-browser with CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol). Use when the user wants to automate their existing Chrome browser, see browser actions in real-time, or needs to control the Chrome instance they're already using. Handles installation, setup, connecting via remote debugging, and all browser automation tasks with live visual feedback.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用真实浏览器自动执行网页操作并实时查看反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制Chrome浏览器完成重复网页操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate web tasks in your real Chrome browser with live visual feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control Chrome programmatically for repetitive web tasks

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能操控你正在用的 Chrome 浏览器:打开网页、填表、点击、按回车、截图,并告诉你页面上有什么。操作全程在你自己的浏览器窗口里可见,登录状态会被保留。
howto.when: 当你想自动化操控自己正在用的 Chrome、想实时看到浏览器操作过程,或需要控制当前这个 Chrome 实例时触发。首次使用前,技能会先自动安装必要依赖。

say.text: 帮我在小红书搜 labubu,把结果截图给我看
say.note: 会在你的 Chrome 里执行搜索并截图展示结果。

say.text: 打开 example.com,把搜索框填上内容再回车
say.note: 会先读取页面可交互元素,再填入并回车。

say.text: 用我 Chrome 的登录状态打开邮箱,截图首页
say.note: 登录状态已保留,无需重新登录。

howto.what_en: Claude can drive the user's existing Chrome: open pages, fill forms, press keys, screenshot, and report what's on screen. Actions run via CDP (port 9222) and appear live in the user's own browser window; login states persist across sessions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to automate their open Chrome, see browser actions in real time, or control the Chrome instance they're already using. Before first use, it auto-installs dependencies.

say_en.text: Search xiaohongshu for labubu and screenshot the results for me.
say_en.note: Runs the search in your Chrome and shows a screenshot.

say_en.text: Open example.com, fill the search box with something, then press Enter.
say_en.note: Reads interactive elements, fills in, and submits.

say_en.text: Use my saved Chrome login to open my mailbox and screenshot the homepage.
say_en.note: Login state is preserved, so no sign-in is needed.
